recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future changes to CDSHooksGuidanceResponse should be handled in HL7/cds-hooks-clinical-reasoning rather than by restoring the profile to the core FHIR build.
issue_request: FHIR-18243 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking the base specification to define a CDSHooksGuidanceResponse profile to support mapping GuidanceResponse to CDS Hooks responses.
initial_application: Git commit 9b36f847bdd7124a47e9dee6fbc4e307f4e0f7c6, titled "GF#18243: Added CDSHooksGuidanceResponse profile", added source/guidanceresponse/guidanceresponse-cdshooks-spreadsheet.xml and updated the GuidanceResponse spreadsheet, so the issue was initially applied in core.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and explicitly directed removing CDSHooksGuidanceResponse and related CDS Hooks profiles from the base specification and moving them to a Using CDS Hooks with FHIR IG. FHIR-53085 then moved CDS-on-FHIR page content and relevant profile/concept-map material to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. Core commit 6abb14540e3fb2242095bca267cd1f48221c5b93 removed the GuidanceResponse CDS Hooks implementation guide, structuredefinition-profile-cdshooksguidanceresponse.xml, and pack-list entry. Current core GuidanceResponse remains active but has no CDS Hooks profile pack entry and links readers to the external IG, which contains StructureDefinition-cdshooksguidanceresponse.json under the IG canonical URL.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the profile to core would contradict later applied CDS work that removed/moved CDS Hooks profiles from the base specification.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision to remove CDSHooksGuidanceResponse and related CDS Hooks profiles from the base specification and move them to the CDS Hooks/FHIR IG.
